heading: `within <dur>`
text:
### `within <dur>` [RLOW.5.4]

A `within <dur>` constraint on a bare pattern compiles to
the pattern's alpha node plus a join test comparing the
fact's age — the monotonic clock's sample minus the fact's entry
stamp ([LTIM.2.8.6]) — against the duration converted to
nanoseconds, re-evaluated as the
`$ClockTick` fact advances ([IRET.7.5],
[IRET.19.5]).

idris.name: ltim_2_7_1__within_three
idris.note: `within <dur>` on a bare pattern as a join test comparing the fact's age -- the monotonic sample less the entry stamp -- against the duration: `dwell < d`, re-evaluated at every pump's re-time. The alpha node is the pattern's own; the conversion to nanoseconds is the lowering's. A fixture.
